data.title: 莉雅丝 · 纯血恶魔破灭之翼
data.description: 【莉雅丝 · 纯血恶魔破灭之翼】旧校舍顶端破碎的红月夜空之下，莉雅丝悬浮半空展开两柄深邃漆黑的恶魔蝠翼。鲜红如血的及膝长发在狂暴魔力气流中肆意翻涌，足尖悬空，掌心凝聚起吉蒙里一族毁灭之力的深红魔法阵——「只要有我在，没有任何人能动我的眷属分毫。」
data.location: 驹王学园旧校舍钟楼顶层夜空
data.action: 展开漆黑恶魔双翼悬浮于夜空，掌心凝聚深红吉蒙里魔力阵，眼眸冷冽威严凝视前方
data.lighting: 猩红月光与掌心魔力光晕交织
data.camera: cowboy shot, low angle, dynamic framing
data.promptProse: Above the old school building, Rias Gremory hovers in her crimson-and-black embroidered noble combat dress, broad bat wings spread and a Gremory seal gathering in her palm. Her red hair streams through the magical current as she looks toward the threat. The low cowboy view includes the roof edge below and fractured-looking red night sky behind. Moonlight rims wing tips; palm magic lights her fingers and cheek.
